args.note: AGC subroutines have no formal parameter list (why_gitgalaxy_beats_ast_here.md Claim 1's shape) -- args is a real body-idiom proxy: the number of DISTINCT accumulator-style registers (A/Q/L/Z) a function's body demonstrably reads via a real math/memory opcode, plus one more if an EBANK=/FBANK=/BBANK= bank-context assignment is present. Fixed in gitgalaxy/core/detector.py's new _count_agc_register_args (#1949 follow-up) to scan every match in the body (findall) instead of deriving from only the first regex match (search-then-split), which previously produced a near-meaningless 0/1/2 categorical value regardless of how many registers a function actually touched. Spot-checked by hand against direct source reading for 5 functions across 4 different corpus files (P40AUTO=1 register A, TESTBIT=1 register A via CCS A before a TC Q early-return truncates the rest, SMODECHK=0 no coupled-register opcode present, KILLTASK=3 registers A+Q plus an EBANK= bank assignment, CGCALC=3 registers A+L plus an EBANK= bank assignment) -- zero discrepancies found. Total is the sum of every real function's own distinct-register-plus-bank-flag count across the corpus, computed via the same struct_func_start/function_data pipeline path abap's own args entry uses. ctags emits no signature: field for Asm-parsed files, so no second tool can ever corroborate this metric -- confirmed via `ctags --fields=+S`, same structural limitation as the whole-language 1-tool case, scoped here to just the args metric (agc_assembly has real ctags coverage for func/class existence).

class.note: class_start (FROM, one per build stage) named-extraction verified two ways across the same 4-file corpus after #1974 (which added dockerfile to _CLASS_START_NAMED_EXTRACTION_LANGS and extended the regex to capture the real AS <alias> stage name, or fall back to the bare base-image reference for an unaliased stage): (1) class_data row counts match struct_class_start exactly (69/6/1/1). (2) independent grep -icE '^[ \t]*FROM([ \t]|\\)' cross-check (not the naive '^[ \t]*FROM' alone, which false-positive-matches an unrelated ENV var named FROM_DOCKERFILE in windows.Dockerfile:185 -- confirmed a real regex-boundary requirement, not a bug) also matches 1/6/1/69 exactly. Extracted stage NAMES independently spot-checked against direct source reading: generate-files.Dockerfile's all 6 aliased stages (base/src/tools/generated/update/validate) match exactly; syscall.Dockerfile's one unaliased stage correctly falls back to its base-image reference (debian:${BASE_DEBIAN_DISTRO}-slim); daemon.Dockerfile's first 5 and last 5 of 69 stages (including two --platform=$VAR-prefixed ones, xx and build-dummy) all match exactly. Prior to #1974, dockerfile had no named class extraction at all (class_data was always empty regardless of struct_class_start's own accurate count) -- see docs/language_status/dockerfile.md §9 for the earlier, narrower raw-signal-only verification this entry supersedes for the 'Classes Found'/'Class Precision' chart panels specifically.

function.note: func_start (RUN/CMD/ENTRYPOINT/HEALTHCHECK) verified two ways across the 4 real Dockerfiles in language-crucible/data/dockerfile/moby/test_targets/ (syscall/generate-files/windows/daemon, 1030 total lines): (1) raw regex applied directly to source text, cross-checked against an independent grep -icE '^[ \t]*(RUN|CMD|ENTRYPOINT|HEALTHCHECK)([ \t\[]|\\)' -- exact match on all 4 files (3/6/4/58). (2) real pipeline DB output (galaxyscope --db-only, file_data.struct_func_start vs. function_count) -- pre-fix, function_count catastrophically undercounted the raw signal (15/1/0/1 vs. the correct 58/6/3/4) because dockerfile had no ScopeParsingRegistry entry and fell through to Mode_B_Braces, which only 'succeeded' when a `{` happened to appear by coincidence within the search window (almost always an unrelated LATER instruction's `${VAR}` template-substitution brace, e.g. RUN at daemon.Dockerfile:57 was 'sliced' using the `{`/`}` from an unrelated FROM line's ${GOLANG_IMAGE} five lines and one build-stage boundary later). Fixed by routing dockerfile to Mode A (_slice_by_labels, the same greedy-to-next-match heuristic already used for abap/cobol/fortran/assembly -- correct here too since Dockerfile instructions have no brace-delimited bodies at all, they simply end at the next instruction). Re-verified post-fix: function_count == struct_func_start exactly on all 4 files (58/6/3/4). Full differential scan against the ~80-repo crucible corpus confirmed the fix generalizes (a 5th real occurrence, shell/brew/Dockerfile, also corrected) with zero unrelated-language diffs. See docs/language_status/dockerfile.md §9 and GitHub issue #1973 for a distinct, narrower follow-on (Mode A's per-function args count can spuriously attribute an unrelated ARG line swept into the greedy body span -- doesn't affect this function-existence verification).

class.note: class_start (JCL JOB cards) verified against the full language-crucible v1.1.0 corpus (185 .jcl files, 5 repos). Two independent checks over all 184 pipeline-scanned files: (1) GitGalaxy's class_start regex vs. an independent JOB-card grep (^//[A-Za-z0-9@#$][A-Za-z0-9@#$]{0,7}[ \t]+JOB([ \t]|$), no shared implementation, independently rejects //*-commented job cards) -- exact agreement, 117 == 117, zero per-file mismatches. The 12 cics-banking-sample-application-cbsa/CREL0*.jcl + CREDB2L.jcl files whose entire JOB card is commented out (//*NAME JOB ...) and the 2 cics-genapp sampcma/sampwui.jcl files whose jobname is an angle-bracket placeholder (//<CMASAPPL> JOB) are correctly NOT counted -- confirmed by direct source read. (2) real pipeline DB output: struct_class_start == class_count == 117 on every file (JCL is in _CLASS_START_NAMED_EXTRACTION_LANGS since #2203, so no brace-slice fallback). Every corpus file carries at most one JOB card. Zero false positives. Count moved 116 -> 117 when #2415 (aperture.py infra_path_pattern left-boundary) was fixed in the same PR, letting DBRMLIB.jcl through the perimeter -- raw-corpus and pipeline now agree at 117/117. See docs/language_status/jcl.md #9.

function.note: func_start (JCL EXEC steps) verified against the full language-crucible v1.1.0 corpus (185 .jcl files, 5 repos). Two independent checks over all 184 pipeline-scanned files: (1) GitGalaxy's func_start regex applied directly to raw source text, cross-checked line-for-line against an independent grep (^//[A-Za-z0-9@#$]{0,8}[ \t]+EXEC([ \t]|$), which shares no implementation with the primary regex and independently excludes //* comment lines) -- exact agreement, 375 == 375, zero per-file mismatches. (2) real pipeline DB output (galaxyscope --db-only): file_data.struct_func_start == function_count == 375 on every file, so neither prism.py's comment splitter nor detector.py's Mode A (_slice_by_labels) body slicing drops or corrupts any match before extraction. Spot-read against direct source for EXEC steps across itpll.jcl, CBL0001J.jcl, RUNASAM1.jcl including unnamed '// EXEC CICS,MEMBER=' statements (correctly matched with an empty step name). Zero false positives: every match is a real EXEC statement. Count moved 370 -> 375 when #2415 (aperture.py infra_path_pattern matched 'gen'/'lib' as filename substrings, dropping MAPGEN.jcl and DBRMLIB.jcl) was fixed in the same PR -- raw-corpus and pipeline now agree at 375/375. See docs/language_status/jcl.md #9.

class.note: class_start named extraction, verified by direct source cross-check of EVERY detected class against its declaration line across the whole language-crucible/data/livecode corpus (98 ingested files): 58/58 correct, ZERO false positives. Two real declaration forms, both handled: `.livecodescript` `script "Name"` (quoted object-script export header) and `.lcb` `module com.x.y` (bareword reverse-DNS). Fixes shipped in the original 2026-08-28 pass: the class_start regex only captured barewords (added a quoted-name branch), and livecode was missing from detector.py's _CLASS_START_NAMED_EXTRACTION_LANGS (added). `total` is GitGalaxy's own live class-claim count (58), matching the chart's staleness anchor; this is a PRECISION record. Count moved 57 -> 58 on 2026-08-29 when #2415 (aperture.py infra_path_pattern left-boundary) was fixed, letting `livecode/livecode/testlib.lcb` (matched `test`/`lib` as filename substrings) through the perimeter -- its `module com.livecode.__INTERNAL._testlib.tests` declaration on line 1 is correctly extracted (bareword reverse-DNS form). Separately, GitGalaxy has a RECALL gap of 39 more real `.livecodescript` objects that it misses entirely because a leading UTF-8 BOM on line 1 defeats the `^`-anchored regex -- a general engine gap affecting 58 corpus files across 6 languages, filed as #2411, not a livecode class_start defect (one of those 39, `revhtml5urllibrary.livecodescript`, was also newly un-blocked by #2415's fix but stays uncounted for the BOM reason). `map.lcb` is correctly NOT counted (its `module` line is commented out). See docs/language_status/livecode.md.

function.note: func_start named extraction, verified by direct source cross-check of EVERY detected handler against its declaration line across the whole language-crucible/data/livecode corpus (98 ingested files, ~900 real handlers): 934/934 handler headers map 1:1 to a real definition, ZERO false positives, ZERO missed. Both dialects handled after #2409/#2410: LiveCode Script `[public|private] on|command|function|getprop|setprop <name>` (unparenthesized args) and LiveCode Builder `.lcb` `[public|private] handler <name>(...)` (typed, parenthesized). `foreign handler` FFI binding declarations (344 in the corpus -- C-prototype shaped, `binds to "<builtin>"`, no body) are correctly NOT counted, and `handler type <Name>()` (a function-pointer typedef, not a callable) is not counted. `total` is GitGalaxy's own live func-claim count (934), the chart's staleness anchor (matches both func_recall.matched_consensus and func_precision.total_slots); this is a PRECISION record for handler *existence*. #2410 routed livecode to detector.py Mode D (keyword depth-tracking) -- before this PR, Mode B brace-slicing produced exactly ONE FunctionNode for the entire corpus (781 correct raw signals, 780 dropped). Known body-extent limitation, does not affect the existence count above: exactly 1 of the 934 (`addExternalFromFile` in revsaveasandroidstandalone.livecodescript, a 2183-line file) over-extends its body because `_apply_literal_shield` mis-handles a `/*` / `*/` sequence sitting inside a LiveCode string literal (`"Android/*"` / `"*/R.java"`), blanking the handler's own `end` lines -- filed as #2419. Independent-scanner method + full name-diff: see docs/language_status/livecode.md §9.
